chunks: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, was given glad tidings of a daughter. Then he looked at the faces of his companions and saw displeasure in them.
So he said: What is the matter with you? She is a sweet flower that I smell, and her sustenance is upon Allah, the Mighty and Majestic.
And he, peace be upon him, was a father of daughters.

key_terms.اَلْكَرَاهَةَ: displeasure or aversion shown by some present
key_terms.بِابْنَةٍ: a daughter; the child whose birth was announced
key_terms.رَيْحَانَةٌ: a sweet flower; an expression of tenderness and affection
key_terms.رِزْقُهَا: her sustenance or provision, granted by Allah

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about the birth of daughters?
ai.summary: This hadith shows the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله rejecting displeasure at the birth of a daughter and expressing affection and honor toward girls. It teaches that daughters are a blessing, that their provision is guaranteed by Allah عزّ وجلّ, and that negative social attitudes toward them are blameworthy.
